content.thinking: The inconsistency profile returns the inconsistent shape (without the guard_ns key) — so a guard is needed. Fix the aggregation script.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import random, sys, collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import gen, algo
dist = collections.Counter(); ndist = collections.Counter()
for s in range(300, 450):
    rng = random.Random(s)
    profile, inc, x = gen.gen_profile(rng)
    fabric, P = gen.gen_fabric(rng, K=profile['groups'])
    plan = algo.compile_plan(profile, fabric)
    if plan['status'] != 'ok':
        dist['inconsistent-profile'] += 1
        continue
    if plan['guard_ns'] is None:
        dist['no-safe-guard'] += 1
        continue
    dist['ok'] += 1
    ndist[plan['warmup_cycle']] += 1
print('cases:', dict(dist))
print('warmup:', dict(sorted(ndist.items())))
PYEOF
